name: Dime
long_description: As developers, we’re constantly going through the cycle of starting to write tests, deciding we can’t prioritize them because we need to ship new features, and then running into bugs in production as a result. Autotest lets you build comprehensive integration tests for your website with basically no work on your part, so you get the benefits of testing without wasting dev time on it.
one_liner: Instant E2E tests for your website

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Hey! I'm Ben. SF native, been in love with building great software products since I learned what a for loop was. Studied CS at Stanford, then did ads ML at Google. Excited to be at Dime, building a product that makes developer's lives easier.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Hi! I'm Aaron. I grew up in San Francisco, studied math and biology at the University of Chicago, and eventually went on to work as a software engineer at a high frequency trading firm. After a super fun but somewhat emotionally dissatisfying year and a half, I started Dime with Ben! When I'm not working on Dime, you can find me at the local dog park, swimming in lake Michigan, or getting absolutely wrecked on chess.com
